test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some pencils are lanterns

All lanterns are rubbers

Some candies are pencils.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some candies are lanterns

(II) Some rubbers are candies

(III) All pencils are rubbers

options.text: Either conclusion I or III follows

solution:
Statements:

Some pencils are lanterns

All lanterns are rubbers

Some candies are pencils.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2802afd0b0cf68c3f30dab939bb43ff479f367f54cdbcf44b3198280baaec41b.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some candies are lanterns - **False **(because there is no direct relation between candies and lanterns so it can be possible but not definite)

(II) Some rubbers are candies - False (because there is no direct relation between candies and rubbers so it can be possible but not definite)

(III) All pencils are rubbers - False (because Some pencils are lanterns and All lanterns are rubbers. So, All pencils are rubbers it can be possible but not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is** "None of the conclusions follow".**
